# Agent Improvement Engine — Implementation Plan

## Context

Entire CLI collects rich session data (transcripts, token usage, AI summaries with friction/learnings, attribution metrics) but doesn't use it to help users improve. We're building three features:

1. **`entire insights`** — Session quality scoring, trends, agent comparisons
2. **`entire improve`** — Analyze friction patterns → suggest context file improvements
3. **Evolution loop** — Auto-trigger improvement suggestions after N sessions

### Architecture Decisions

| Decision | Choice | Why |
|----------|--------|-----|
| Local cache | SQLite (`modernc.org/sqlite`) | 2000 sessions/month scale needs indexed queries; bbolt would require hand-written query engine |
| Computed analytics storage | `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch, top-level `insights/` directory | Pre-computed scores/suggestions push to remote via existing pre-push hook; future frontend reads them directly |
| Raw data | Already on `entire/checkpoints/v1` | Transcripts, summaries, friction, tokens already stored and pushed |
| Binary size | +~8MB (32MB → 40MB) | Acceptable tradeoff for SQL query ergonomics at scale |
| Build constraint | `CGO_ENABLED=0` → `modernc.org/sqlite` (pure Go) | Only option; `.goreleaser.yaml` enforces static binary |
| Summarization | Required — `entire insights` and `entire improve` exit with message if disabled | Summaries (friction, learnings, intent/outcome) are the primary data source; scoring on tokens alone isn't useful enough |

---

## Data Architecture

### Three-Layer Storage

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 1: SQLite (.entire/insights.db)  — LOCAL CACHE       │
│  Fast indexed queries for CLI commands                      │
│  Populated from entire/checkpoints/v1                       │
│  Disposable — delete and rebuild from git                   │
└────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
                         │ reads from / writes to
                         ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 2: entire/checkpoints/v1 branch  — SOURCE OF TRUTH   │
│                                                             │
│  Existing (raw data):                                       │
│    <id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/                                       │
│      metadata.json          (CheckpointSummary)             │
│      0/metadata.json        (session: tokens, summary,      │
│      0/full.jsonl            friction, learnings, etc.)     │
│                                                             │
│  NEW (computed analytics):                                  │
│    insights/                                                │
│      scores/                                                │
│        <checkpoint-id>.json (SessionScore per checkpoint)   │
│      report.json            (latest InsightsReport)         │
│      suggestions/                                           │
│        <suggestion-id>.json (improvement suggestions)       │
│      evolution.json         (evolve state + history)        │
│                                                             │
└────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
                         │ git push (pre-push hook, already exists)
                         ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 3: Git Remote  — SHARED STATE                        │
│  Future frontend reads insights/ directory directly         │
│  No new API needed — git is the transport                   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### `insights/` Directory Schema (on `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch)

```
insights/
├── scores/
│   └── <checkpoint-id>.json     # Per-checkpoint session score
│       {
│         "checkpoint_id": "a3b2c4d5e6f7",
│         "session_id": "2026-03-24-uuid",
│         "agent": "Claude Code",
│         "model": "sonnet",
│         "created_at": "2026-03-24T12:00:00Z",
│         "overall": 78.5,
│         "breakdown": {
│           "token_efficiency": 80,
│           "first_pass_success": 75,
│           "friction_score": 90,
│           "focus_score": 60
│         },
│         "tokens_used": 5000,
│         "turn_count": 3,
│         "files_count": 3,
│         "friction_count": 1
│       }
│
├── report.json                  # Latest aggregated insights report
│   {
│     "generated_at": "2026-03-24T12:00:00Z",
│     "period": "last 30 sessions",
│     "trends": [...],
│     "agent_comparisons": [...],
│     "session_count": 30
│   }
│
├── suggestions/
│   └── <suggestion-id>.json     # Individual improvement suggestion
│       {
│         "id": "sug-1711234567-0",
│         "file_type": "CLAUDE.md",
│         "category": "fix_friction",
│         "title": "Add linting reminder",
│         "description": "Lint failures in 3 of 10 sessions",
│         "evidence": ["session-1", "session-2"],
│         "priority": "high",
│         "diff": "...",
│         "status": "pending",
│         "created_at": "2026-03-24T12:00:00Z"
│       }
│
└── evolution.json               # Evolution loop state
    {
      "sessions_since_last_run": 3,
      "last_run_at": "2026-03-24T12:00:00Z",
      "total_runs": 5,
      "suggestions_generated": 12,
      "suggestions_accepted": 7
    }
```

### SQLite Schema (`.entire/insights.db` — local cache)

```sql
-- Cache freshness tracking
CREATE TABLE cache_meta (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
);
-- Stores: 'branch_tip' → commit hash, 'last_rebuild' → timestamp

-- Denormalized session data for fast queries
CREATE TABLE sessions (
    checkpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    agent TEXT,
    model TEXT,
    branch TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    input_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    cache_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    output_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    api_call_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    duration_ms INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    turn_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    intent TEXT,
    outcome TEXT,
    agent_percentage REAL DEFAULT 0,
    -- Pre-computed score (also written to branch)
    overall_score REAL,
    score_token_efficiency REAL,
    score_first_pass REAL,
    score_friction REAL,
    score_focus REAL,
    PRIMARY KEY (checkpoint_id, session_index)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_created ON sessions(created_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_agent ON sessions(agent);

CREATE TABLE files_touched (
    checkpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    file_path TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE friction (
    checkpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    text TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX idx_friction_text ON friction(text);

CREATE TABLE learnings (
    checkpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    scope TEXT NOT NULL,
    finding TEXT NOT NULL,
    path TEXT
);

-- Suggestion tracking (also written to branch)
CREATE TABLE suggestions (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    file_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    diff TEXT,
    priority TEXT DEFAULT 'medium',
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    resolved_at TEXT
);
```

## File Structure

### New Packages

```
cmd/entire/cli/
├── insightsdb/                    # SQLite cache layer
│   ├── db.go                      # Open/close, migrations, WAL setup
│   ├── db_test.go

│
├── insights/                      # Scoring + trends (pure logic, no I/O)
│   ├── insights.go                # Types: SessionScore, Trend, AgentComparison
│   ├── scorer.go                  # Composite quality scoring
│   ├── scorer_test.go
│   ├── trends.go                  # Cross-session trends + agent comparisons
│   ├── trends_test.go
│
├── improve/                       # Context file improvement
│   ├── improve.go                 # Types: Suggestion, ContextFile, ImprovementReport
│   ├── context_files.go           # Detect CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, .gemini
│   ├── context_files_test.go
│   ├── analyzer.go                # Extract friction patterns from session data
│   ├── analyzer_test.go

│
```

### Modified Files

```

cmd/entire/cli/settings/settings.go                  # Add evolve settings
cmd/entire/cli/status_style.go                       # Delegate to termstyle
cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/committed.go               # Write insights/ tree to branch
go.mod                                               # Add modernc.org/sqlite
```

---

## Implementation Phases

### Phase 1: Foundation

**1a. `termstyle/` package** — Extract shared styles from `status_style.go`
- `Styles` struct, `New(w)`, `Render()`, `SectionRule()`, `FormatTokenCount()`, etc.
- Refactor `status_style.go` to delegate

**1b. SQLite cache** (`insightsdb/`)
- `db.go`: Open `.entire/insights.db`, WAL mode, migrations
- `cache.go`: `Rebuild()` from `entire/checkpoints/v1` via existing `GitStore.ListCommitted()` + `ReadSessionContent()`
- `RefreshIfStale()`: compare branch tip hash, rebuild only if changed
- `queries.go`: SQL functions for filter/aggregate/trend queries

**1c. Settings** — Add `EvolveSettings` to `settings.go`

### Phase 2: Scoring & Insights

**2a. `insights/` package** (pure logic, no I/O)
- `scorer.go`: `ScoreSession()` — composite scoring (token efficiency 30%, first-pass 30%, friction 25%, focus 15%)
- `trends.go`: `ComputeTrends()`, `ComputeAgentComparisons()`

**2b. Write scores to checkpoint branch**
- After scoring, write `insights/scores/<checkpoint-id>.json` to `entire/checkpoints/v1` using existing tree surgery (`UpdateSubtree`)
- Write `insights/report.json` with latest aggregated report
- These push to remote via existing pre-push hook

**2c. `entire insights` command**
- **Gate:** Check `settings.IsSummarizeEnabled()` — if false, print message and exit:
  `"Summarization is required for insights. Enable it in .entire/settings.json:\n  { \"strategy_options\": { \"summarize\": { \"enabled\": true } } }"`
- Refresh SQLite cache if stale
- Query scores from cache (or compute + cache if missing)
- Render terminal output using `termstyle`
- Flags: `--last N`, `--agent "name"`, `--json`

### Phase 3: Context Improver

**3a. `improve/` package**
- `context_files.go`: Detect CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, .gemini
- `analyzer.go`: Extract friction patterns from SQLite friction table
- `generator.go`: Claude CLI call (same pattern as `summarize/claude.go`) to generate suggestions

**3b. Write suggestions to checkpoint branch**
- Write `insights/suggestions/<id>.json` for each suggestion
- Pushes with next `git push`

**3c. `entire improve` command**
- **Gate:** Same summarization check as insights
- Query friction patterns from SQLite
- Detect context files
- Generate suggestions via Claude CLI (or `--dry-run` to skip)
- Render colored diffs
- Flags: `--last N`, `--dry-run`, `--json`

### Phase 4: Evolution Loop

**4a. `evolve/` package**
- `trigger.go`: `ShouldTrigger()` checks session count vs threshold
- `tracker.go`: Accept/reject suggestions, measure impact

**4b. Write evolution state to checkpoint branch**
- Write `insights/evolution.json` with evolve state
- Update on session end and after `entire improve` runs

**4c. Hook integration**
- After session stop: increment counter in SQLite + evolution.json
- If threshold met: print tip suggesting `entire improve`

---

## Key Files to Reuse

| What | File:Line | How |
|------|-----------|-----|
| Checkpoint listing | `checkpoint/committed.go:876` `ListCommitted()` | Drives cache population |
| Session content | `checkpoint/committed.go:777` `ReadSessionContent(ctx, id, sessionIndex)` | Read metadata for cache |
| Checkpoint summary | `checkpoint/committed.go:738` `ReadCommitted(ctx, id)` | Get Sessions[] array |
| Summary types | `checkpoint/checkpoint.go:466` `Summary`, `LearningsSummary` | Data for analyzer |
| Token types | `agent/types.go` `TokenUsage` | Flatten for cache |
| Claude CLI pattern | `summarize/claude.go:54` `ClaudeGenerator` | Copy for improve generator |
| Tree surgery | `checkpoint/parse_tree.go:193` `UpdateSubtree` | Write insights/ to branch |
| Branch commit | `checkpoint/committed.go` `WriteCommitted` pattern | Write to entire/checkpoints/v1 |
| Disabled guard | `cli/setup.go` `checkDisabledGuard()` | Check in new commands |
| Open repository | `cli/git_operations.go` `openRepository()` | Used in new commands |
| Repo root | `cli/paths/paths.go` `WorktreeRoot()` | Context file detection |
| Session metrics | `checkpoint/checkpoint.go:459` `SessionMetrics` — `DurationMs`, `TurnCount` | Map to cache |
| Pre-push hook | `strategy/push_common.go` | Already pushes checkpoints/v1 |

---

## Scoring Algorithm

Weights: token efficiency (30%), first-pass success (30%), friction (25%), focus (15%)

| Dimension | Formula | Good | Poor |
|-----------|---------|------|------|
| Token efficiency | `100 * exp(-tokensPerFile/8000)` | 2k tok/file → 78 | 10k → 29 |
| First-pass | `80 - (friction * 10) - (turns>5 * 3) - (openItems * 5)` | 0 friction → 80 | 5 friction → 30 |
| Friction | `100 - (frictionCount * 20)` | 0 → 100 | 5 → 0 |
| Focus | file-to-turn ratio 0.5-3.0 → 90, else scales down | 2 files/3 turns → 90 | 1 file/15 turns → 50 |

---

## Verification

```bash
# Unit tests
mise run test

# Full CI (unit + integration + canary)
mise run fmt && mise run lint && mise run test:ci

# Manual testing
entire insights              # Scores, trends, comparisons
entire insights --last 30    # More sessions
entire insights --json       # Machine-readable output
entire improve --dry-run     # Show patterns without AI call
entire improve               # Generate suggestions
```

### Verify data on branch
```bash
git log entire/checkpoints/v1 --oneline -5  # See insights commits
git show entire/checkpoints/v1:insights/report.json  # Read report
git show entire/checkpoints/v1:insights/scores/  # List score files
```

### Verify push
```bash
git push  # Pre-push hook should push entire/checkpoints/v1 including insights/
```

# Agent Improvement Engine — Implementation Plan

## Context

Entire CLI collects rich session data (transcripts, token usage, AI summaries with friction/learnings, attribution metrics) but doesn't use it to help users improve. We're building three features:

1. **`entire insights`** — Session quality scoring, trends, agent comparisons
2. **`entire improve`** — Analyze friction patterns → suggest context file improvements
3. **Evolution loop** — Auto-trigger improvement suggestions after N sessions

### Architecture Decisions

| Decision | Choice | Why |
|----------|--------|-----|
| Local cache | SQLite (`modernc.org/sqlite`) | 2000 sessions/month scale needs indexed queries; bbolt would require hand-written query engine |
| Computed analytics storage | `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch, top-level `insights/` directory | Pre-computed scores/suggestions push to remote via existing pre-push hook; future frontend reads them directly |
| Raw data | Already on `entire/checkpoints/v1` | Transcripts, summaries, friction, tokens already stored and pushed |
| Binary size | +~8MB (32MB → 40MB) | Acceptable tradeoff for SQL query ergonomics at scale |
| Build constraint | `CGO_ENABLED=0` → `modernc.org/sqlite` (pure Go) | Only option; `.goreleaser.yaml` enforces static binary |
| Summarization | Required — `entire insights` and `entire improve` exit with message if disabled | Summaries (friction, learnings, intent/outcome) are the primary data source; scoring on tokens alone isn't useful enough |
| Score timing | At commit time (in CondenseSession, after summary) | Pure math <1ms; scores always on branch, always pushed, always available for frontend |
| Generator reuse | Shared base package for Claude CLI execution | Extract common logic (CLI invocation, response parsing, git isolation, `stripGitEnv`, `extractJSONFromMarkdown`) into shared package; summarize and improve provide different prompt templates |

---

## Data Architecture

### Three-Layer Storage

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 1: SQLite (.entire/insights.db)  — LOCAL CACHE       │
│  Fast indexed queries for CLI commands                      │
│  Populated from entire/checkpoints/v1                       │
│  Disposable — delete and rebuild from git                   │
└────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
                         │ reads from / writes to
                         ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 2: entire/checkpoints/v1 branch  — SOURCE OF TRUTH   │
│                                                             │
│  Existing (raw data):                                       │
│    <id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/                                       │
│      metadata.json          (CheckpointSummary)             │
│      0/metadata.json        (session: tokens, summary,      │
│      0/full.jsonl            friction, learnings, etc.)     │
│                                                             │
│  NEW (computed analytics):                                  │
│    insights/                                                │
│      scores/                                                │
│        <checkpoint-id>.json (SessionScore per checkpoint)   │
│      report.json            (latest InsightsReport)         │
│      suggestions/                                           │
│        <suggestion-id>.json (improvement suggestions)       │
│      evolution.json         (evolve state + history)        │
│                                                             │
└────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
                         │ git push (pre-push hook, already exists)
                         ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 3: Git Remote  — SHARED STATE                        │
│  Future frontend reads insights/ directory directly         │
│  No new API needed — git is the transport                   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### `insights/` Directory Schema (on `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch)

```
insights/
├── scores/
│   └── <checkpoint-id>.json     # Per-checkpoint session score
│       {
│         "checkpoint_id": "a3b2c4d5e6f7",
│         "session_id": "2026-03-24-uuid",
│         "agent": "Claude Code",
│         "model": "sonnet",
│         "created_at": "2026-03-24T12:00:00Z",
│         "overall": 78.5,
│         "breakdown": {
│           "token_efficiency": 80,
│           "first_pass_success": 75,
│           "friction_score": 90,
│           "focus_score": 60
│         },
│         "tokens_used": 5000,
│         "turn_count": 3,
│         "files_count": 3,
│         "friction_count": 1
│       }
│
├── report.json                  # Latest aggregated insights report
│   {
│     "generated_at": "2026-03-24T12:00:00Z",
│     "period": "last 30 sessions",
│     "trends": [...],
│     "agent_comparisons": [...],
│     "session_count": 30
│   }
│
├── suggestions/
│   └── <suggestion-id>.json     # Individual improvement suggestion
│       {
│         "id": "sug-1711234567-0",
│         "file_type": "CLAUDE.md",
│         "category": "fix_friction",

      "last_run_at": "2026-03-24T12:00:00Z",
      "total_runs": 5,
      "suggestions_generated": 12,
      "suggestions_accepted": 7
    }
```

### SQLite Schema (`.entire/insights.db` — local cache)

```sql
-- Cache freshness tracking
CREATE TABLE cache_meta (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
);
-- Stores: 'branch_tip' → commit hash, 'last_rebuild' → timestamp

-- Denormalized session data for fast queries
CREATE TABLE sessions (
    checkpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    agent TEXT,
    model TEXT,
    branch TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    input_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    cache_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    output_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    api_call_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    duration_ms INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    turn_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    intent TEXT,
    outcome TEXT,
    agent_percentage REAL DEFAULT 0,
    -- Pre-computed score (also written to branch)
    overall_score REAL,
    score_token_efficiency REAL,
    score_first_pass REAL,
    score_friction REAL,
    score_focus REAL,
    PRIMARY KEY (checkpoint_id, session_index)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_created ON sessions(created_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_agent ON sessions(agent);

CREATE TABLE files_touched (
    checkpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    file_path TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE friction (
    checkpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    text TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX idx_friction_text ON friction(text);

CREATE TABLE learnings (
    checkpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    scope TEXT NOT NULL,
    finding TEXT NOT NULL,
    path TEXT
);

-- Suggestion tracking (also written to branch)
CREATE TABLE suggestions (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    file_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    diff TEXT,
    priority TEXT DEFAULT 'medium',
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    resolved_at TEXT
);
```

---

## File Structure

### New Packages

```
cmd/entire/cli/
├── insightsdb/                    # SQLite cache layer
│   ├── db.go                      # Open/close, migrations, WAL setup
│   ├── db_test.go
│   ├── cache.go                   # Populate from entire/checkpoints/v1
│   ├── cache_test.go
│   ├── queries.go                 # SQL query functions
│   ├── queries_test.go
│
├── insights/                      # Scoring + trends (pure logic, no I/O)
│   ├── insights.go                # Types: SessionScore, Trend, AgentComparison
│   ├── scorer.go                  # Composite quality scoring
│   ├── scorer_test.go
│   ├── trends.go                  # Cross-session trends + agent comparisons
│   ├── trends_test.go
│
├── improve/                       # Context file improvement
│   ├── improve.go                 # Types: Suggestion, ContextFile, ImprovementReport
│   ├── context_files.go           # Detect CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, .gemini

│   ├── analyzer_test.go

```

```
cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/committed.go               # Write insights/ tree to branch

```

---

## Implementation Phases

### Phase 1: Foundation

**1a. `termstyle/` package** — Extract shared styles from `status_style.go`
- `Styles` struct, `New(w)`, `Render()`, `SectionRule()`, `FormatTokenCount()`, etc.
- Refactor `status_style.go` to delegate

**1b. SQLite cache** (`insightsdb/`)
- `db.go`: Open `.entire/insights.db`, WAL mode, migrations
- `cache.go`: `Rebuild()` from `entire/checkpoints/v1` via existing `GitStore.ListCommitted()` + `ReadSessionContent()`
- `RefreshIfStale()`: compare branch tip hash, rebuild only if changed
- `queries.go`: SQL functions for filter/aggregate/trend queries

**1c. Settings** — Add `EvolveSettings` to `settings.go`

### Phase 2: Scoring & Insights

**2a. `insights/` package** (pure logic, no I/O)
- `scorer.go`: `ScoreSession()` — composite scoring (token efficiency 30%, first-pass 30%, friction 25%, focus 15%)
- `trends.go`: `ComputeTrends()`, `ComputeAgentComparisons()`

**2b. Write scores to checkpoint branch**
- After scoring, write `insights/scores/<checkpoint-id>.json` to `entire/checkpoints/v1` using existing tree surgery (`UpdateSubtree`)
- Write `insights/report.json` with latest aggregated report
- These push to remote via existing pre-push hook

**2c. `entire insights` command**
- **Gate:** Check `settings.IsSummarizeEnabled()` — if false, print message and exit:
  `"Summarization is required for insights. Enable it in .entire/settings.json:\n  { \"strategy_options\": { \"summarize\": { \"enabled\": true } } }"`
- Refresh SQLite cache if stale
- Query scores from cache (or compute + cache if missing)
- Render terminal output using `termstyle`
- Flags: `--last N`, `--agent "name"`, `--json`

### Phase 3: Context Improver

**3a. `improve/` package**
- `context_files.go`: Detect CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, .gemini
- `analyzer.go`: Extract friction patterns from SQLite friction table
- `generator.go`: Claude CLI call (same pattern as `summarize/claude.go`) to generate suggestions

**3b. Write suggestions to checkpoint branch**
- Write `insights/suggestions/<id>.json` for each suggestion
- Pushes with next `git push`

**3c. `entire improve` command**
- **Gate:** Same summarization check as insights
- Query friction patterns from SQLite
- Detect context files
- Generate suggestions via Claude CLI (or `--dry-run` to skip)
- Render colored diffs
- Flags: `--last N`, `--dry-run`, `--json`

### Phase 4: Evolution Loop

**4a. `evolve/` package**
- `trigger.go`: `ShouldTrigger()` checks session count vs threshold
- `tracker.go`: Accept/reject suggestions, measure impact

**4b. Write evolution state to checkpoint branch**
- Write `insights/evolution.json` with evolve state
- Update on session end and after `entire improve` runs

**4c. Hook integration**
- After session stop: increment counter in SQLite + evolution.json
- If threshold met: print tip suggesting `entire improve`

---

## Key Files to Reuse

| What | File:Line | How |
|------|-----------|-----|
| Checkpoint listing | `checkpoint/committed.go:876` `ListCommitted()` | Drives cache population |
| Session content | `checkpoint/committed.go:777` `ReadSessionContent(ctx, id, sessionIndex)` | Read metadata for cache |
| Checkpoint summary | `checkpoint/committed.go:738` `ReadCommitted(ctx, id)` | Get Sessions[] array |
| Summary types | `checkpoint/checkpoint.go:466` `Summary`, `LearningsSummary` | Data for analyzer |
| Token types | `agent/types.go` `TokenUsage` | Flatten for cache |
| Claude CLI pattern | `summarize/claude.go:54` `ClaudeGenerator` | Copy for improve generator |
| Tree surgery | `checkpoint/parse_tree.go:193` `UpdateSubtree` | Write insights/ to branch |
| Branch commit | `checkpoint/committed.go` `WriteCommitted` pattern | Write to entire/checkpoints/v1 |
| Disabled guard | `cli/setup.go` `checkDisabledGuard()` | Check in new commands |
| Open repository | `cli/git_operations.go` `openRepository()` | Used in new commands |
| Repo root | `cli/paths/paths.go` `WorktreeRoot()` | Context file detection |
| Session metrics | `checkpoint/checkpoint.go:459` `SessionMetrics` — `DurationMs`, `TurnCount` | Map to cache |
| Pre-push hook | `strategy/push_common.go` | Already pushes checkpoints/v1 |

---

## Scoring Algorithm

Weights: token efficiency (30%), first-pass success (30%), friction (25%), focus (15%)

| Dimension | Formula | Good | Poor |
|-----------|---------|------|------|
| Token efficiency | `100 * exp(-tokensPerFile/8000)` | 2k tok/file → 78 | 10k → 29 |
| First-pass | `80 - (friction * 10) - (turns>5 * 3) - (openItems * 5)` | 0 friction → 80 | 5 friction → 30 |
| Friction | `100 - (frictionCount * 20)` | 0 → 100 | 5 → 0 |
| Focus | file-to-turn ratio 0.5-3.0 → 90, else scales down | 2 files/3 turns → 90 | 1 file/15 turns → 50 |

---

## Verification

```bash
# Unit tests
mise run test

# Full CI (unit + integration + canary)
mise run fmt && mise run lint && mise run test:ci

# Manual testing
entire insights              # Scores, trends, comparisons
entire insights --last 30    # More sessions
entire insights --json       # Machine-readable output
entire improve --dry-run     # Show patterns without AI call
entire improve               # Generate suggestions
```

### Verify data on branch
```bash
git log entire/checkpoints/v1 --oneline -5  # See insights commits
git show entire/checkpoints/v1:insights/report.json  # Read report
git show entire/checkpoints/v1:insights/scores/  # List score files
```

### Verify push
```bash
git push  # Pre-push hook should push entire/checkpoints/v1 including insights/
```

  - Write `insights/scores/<checkpoint-id>.json` to `entire/checkpoints/v1` using tree surgery

- This means scores are **always** on the branch and pushed with checkpoints

**2c. `entire insights` command**

- Query scores from cache
- Compute trends + agent comparisons

# Agent Improvement Engine — Implementation Plan

## Context

Entire CLI collects rich session data (transcripts, token usage, AI summaries with friction/learnings, attribution metrics) but doesn't use it to help users improve. We're building three features:

1. **`entire insights`** — Session quality scoring, trends, agent comparisons
2. **`entire improve`** — Analyze friction patterns → suggest context file improvements
3. **Evolution loop** — Auto-trigger improvement suggestions after N sessions

### Architecture Decisions

| Decision | Choice | Why |
|----------|--------|-----|
| Local cache | SQLite (`modernc.org/sqlite`) | 2000 sessions/month scale needs indexed queries; bbolt would require hand-written query engine |
| Computed analytics storage | `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch, top-level `insights/` directory | Pre-computed scores/suggestions push to remote via existing pre-push hook; future frontend reads them directly |
| Raw data | Already on `entire/checkpoints/v1` | Transcripts, summaries, friction, tokens already stored and pushed |
| Binary size | +~8MB (32MB → 40MB) | Acceptable tradeoff for SQL query ergonomics at scale |
| Build constraint | `CGO_ENABLED=0` → `modernc.org/sqlite` (pure Go) | Only option; `.goreleaser.yaml` enforces static binary |
| Summarization | Required — `entire insights` and `entire improve` exit with message if disabled | Summaries (friction, learnings, intent/outcome) are the primary data source; scoring on tokens alone isn't useful enough |
| Score timing | At commit time (in CondenseSession, after summary) | Pure math <1ms; scores always on branch, always pushed, always available for frontend |
| Generator reuse | Shared base package for Claude CLI execution | Extract common logic (CLI invocation, response parsing, git isolation, `stripGitEnv`, `extractJSONFromMarkdown`) into shared package; summarize and improve provide different prompt templates |

---

## Data Architecture

### Three-Layer Storage

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 1: SQLite (.entire/insights.db)  — LOCAL CACHE       │
│  Fast indexed queries for CLI commands                      │
│  Populated from entire/checkpoints/v1                       │
│  Disposable — delete and rebuild from git                   │
└────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
                         │ reads from / writes to
                         ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 2: entire/checkpoints/v1 branch  — SOURCE OF TRUTH   │
│                                                             │
│  Existing (raw data):                                       │
│    <id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/                                       │
│      metadata.json          (CheckpointSummary)             │
│      0/metadata.json        (session: tokens, summary,      │
│      0/full.jsonl            friction, learnings, etc.)     │
│                                                             │
│  NEW (computed analytics):                                  │
│    insights/                                                │
│      scores/                                                │
│        <checkpoint-id>.json (SessionScore per checkpoint)   │
│      report.json            (latest InsightsReport)         │
│      suggestions/                                           │
│        <suggestion-id>.json (improvement suggestions)       │
│      evolution.json         (evolve state + history)        │
│                                                             │
└────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
                         │ git push (pre-push hook, already exists)
                         ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 3: Git Remote  — SHARED STATE                        │
│  Future frontend reads insights/ directory directly         │
│  No new API needed — git is the transport                   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### `insights/` Directory Schema (on `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch)

```
insights/
├── scores/
│   └── <checkpoint-id>.json     # Per-checkpoint session score
│       {
│         "checkpoint_id": "a3b2c4d5e6f7",
│         "session_id": "2026-03-24-uuid",
│         "agent": "Claude Code",
│         "model": "sonnet",
│         "created_at": "2026-03-24T12:00:00Z",
│         "overall": 78.5,
│         "breakdown": {
│           "token_efficiency": 80,
│           "first_pass_success": 75,
│           "friction_score": 90,
│           "focus_score": 60
│         },
│         "tokens_used": 5000,
│         "turn_count": 3,
│         "files_count": 3,
│         "friction_count": 1
│       }
│
├── report.json                  # Latest aggregated insights report
│   {
│     "generated_at": "2026-03-24T12:00:00Z",
│     "period": "last 30 sessions",
│     "trends": [...],
│     "agent_comparisons": [...],
│     "session_count": 30
│   }
│
├── suggestions/
│   └── <suggestion-id>.json     # Individual improvement suggestion
│       {
│         "id": "sug-1711234567-0",
│         "file_type": "CLAUDE.md",
│         "category": "fix_friction",
│         "title": "Add linting reminder",
│         "description": "Lint failures in 3 of 10 sessions",
│         "evidence": ["session-1", "session-2"],
│         "priority": "high",
│         "diff": "...",
│         "status": "pending",
│         "created_at": "2026-03-24T12:00:00Z"
│       }
│
└── evolution.json               # Evolution loop state
    {
      "sessions_since_last_run": 3,
      "last_run_at": "2026-03-24T12:00:00Z",
      "total_runs": 5,
      "suggestions_generated": 12,
      "suggestions_accepted": 7
    }
```

### SQLite Schema (`.entire/insights.db` — local cache)

```sql
-- Cache freshness tracking
CREATE TABLE cache_meta (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
);
-- Stores: 'branch_tip' → commit hash, 'last_rebuild' → timestamp

-- Denormalized session data for fast queries
CREATE TABLE sessions (
    checkpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    agent TEXT,
    model TEXT,
    branch TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    input_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    cache_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    output_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    api_call_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    duration_ms INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    turn_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    intent TEXT,
    outcome TEXT,
    agent_percentage REAL DEFAULT 0,
    -- Pre-computed score (also written to branch)
    overall_score REAL,
    score_token_efficiency REAL,
    score_first_pass REAL,
    score_friction REAL,
    score_focus REAL,
    PRIMARY KEY (checkpoint_id, session_index)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_created ON sessions(created_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_agent ON sessions(agent);

CREATE TABLE files_touched (
    checkpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    file_path TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE friction (
    checkpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    text TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX idx_friction_text ON friction(text);

CREATE TABLE learnings (
    checkpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    scope TEXT NOT NULL,
    finding TEXT NOT NULL,
    path TEXT
);

-- Suggestion tracking (also written to branch)
CREATE TABLE suggestions (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    file_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    diff TEXT,
    priority TEXT DEFAULT 'medium',
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    resolved_at TEXT
);
```

Weights: token efficiency (30%), first-pass success (30%), friction (25%), focus (15%)

| Friction | `100 - (frictionCount * 20)` | 0 → 100 | 5 → 0 |
| Focus | file-to-turn ratio 0.5-3.0 → 90, else scales down | 2 files/3 turns → 90 | 1 file/15 turns → 50 |

# Agent Improvement Engine — Implementation Plan

## Context

Entire CLI collects rich session data (transcripts, token usage, AI summaries with friction/learnings, attribution metrics) but doesn't use it to help users improve. We're building three features:

1. **`entire insights`** — Session quality scoring, trends, agent comparisons
2. **`entire improve`** — Analyze friction patterns → suggest context file improvements
3. **Evolution loop** — Auto-trigger improvement suggestions after N sessions

### Architecture Decisions

| Decision | Choice | Why |
|----------|--------|-----|
| Local cache | SQLite (`modernc.org/sqlite`) | 2000 sessions/month scale needs indexed queries; bbolt would require hand-written query engine |
| Computed analytics storage | `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch, top-level `insights/` directory | Pre-computed scores/suggestions push to remote via existing pre-push hook; future frontend reads them directly |
| Raw data | Already on `entire/checkpoints/v1` | Transcripts, summaries, friction, tokens already stored and pushed |
| Binary size | +~8MB (32MB → 40MB) | Acceptable tradeoff for SQL query ergonomics at scale |
| Build constraint | `CGO_ENABLED=0` → `modernc.org/sqlite` (pure Go) | Only option; `.goreleaser.yaml` enforces static binary |
| Summarization | Required — `entire insights` and `entire improve` exit with message if disabled | Summaries (friction, learnings, intent/outcome) are the primary data source; scoring on tokens alone isn't useful enough |
| Score timing | At commit time (in CondenseSession, after summary) | Pure math <1ms; scores always on branch, always pushed, always available for frontend |
| Generator reuse | Shared base package for Claude CLI execution | Extract common logic (CLI invocation, response parsing, git isolation, `stripGitEnv`, `extractJSONFromMarkdown`) into shared package; summarize and improve provide different prompt templates |

---

## Data Architecture

### Three-Layer Storage

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 1: SQLite (.entire/insights.db)  — LOCAL CACHE       │
│  Fast indexed queries for CLI commands                      │
│  Populated from entire/checkpoints/v1                       │
│  Disposable — delete and rebuild from git                   │
└────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
                         │ reads from / writes to
                         ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 2: entire/checkpoints/v1 branch  — SOURCE OF TRUTH   │
│                                                             │
│  Existing (raw data):                                       │
│    <id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/                                       │
│      metadata.json          (CheckpointSummary)             │
│      0/metadata.json        (session: tokens, summary,      │
│      0/full.jsonl            friction, learnings, etc.)     │
│                                                             │
│  NEW (computed analytics):                                  │
│    insights/                                                │
│      scores/                                                │
│        <checkpoint-id>.json (SessionScore per checkpoint)   │
│      report.json            (latest InsightsReport)         │
│      suggestions/                                           │
│        <suggestion-id>.json (improvement suggestions)       │
│      evolution.json         (evolve state + history)        │
│                                                             │
└────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
                         │ git push (pre-push hook, already exists)
                         ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 3: Git Remote  — SHARED STATE                        │
│  Future frontend reads insights/ directory directly         │
│  No new API needed — git is the transport                   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Scoring Algorithm

Weights: token efficiency (30%), first-pass success (30%), friction (25%), focus (15%)

| Dimension | Formula | Good | Poor |
|-----------|---------|------|------|
| Token efficiency | `100 * exp(-tokensPerFile/8000)` | 2k tok/file → 78 | 10k → 29 |
| First-pass | `80 - (friction * 10) - (turns>5 * 3) - (openItems * 5)` | 0 friction → 80 | 5 friction → 30 |
| Friction | `100 - (frictionCount * 20)` | 0 → 100 | 5 → 0 |
| Focus | file-to-turn ratio 0.5-3.0 → 90, else scales down | 2 files/3 turns → 90 | 1 file/15 turns → 50 |

content.text:
That's a really sharp observation. Let me think through this properly.

## What Summarize Actually Captures

The summary's friction field is **high-level and terse**:

```json
{
  "friction": [
    "Had to retry due to missing import",
    "Lint errors not caught by agent"
  ]
}
```

That's it — one sentence per friction point. There's no detail about:
- What the agent actually tried and failed at
- How many iterations it took to fix
- What the transcript conversation looked like around the friction
- What tool calls failed and why
- What the agent's reasoning was when it went wrong

## What `entire improve` Actually Needs

To generate a **good** CLAUDE.md suggestion like "Always run `mise run lint` before committing", the improve generator needs to understand the *pattern*, not just the label. For example:

**Shallow (from summary only):**
> "Linting issues occurred 3 times" → suggest "run linter"

**Deep (from transcript context around friction):**
> Session 1: Agent wrote 50 lines, didn't run lint, CI caught 4 errors, spent 3 turns fixing
> Session 2: Agent ran `go build` but not `golangci-lint`, missed unused variable
> Session 3: Agent used wrong lint command (`go vet` instead of `mise run lint`)
> → suggest: "Always run `mise run lint` (not `go vet`) before committing. The project uses golangci-lint with custom rules in `.golangci.yml`."

The second suggestion is **much more actionable** because it understands the specific failure mode.

## The Real Data Flow Should Be

```
Step 1: SQLite identifies WHICH sessions to dig into
        (query: sessions with high friction count, recurring themes)

Step 2: For those sessions, read the actual transcript
        from entire/checkpoints/v1 (full.jsonl)

Step 3: Extract transcript context around friction points
        (the conversation before/after the friction occurred)

Step 4: Feed transcript excerpts + friction themes + context files
        to Claude CLI for deep analysis + suggestion generation
```

SQLite is the **index** — it tells you where to look. The transcripts are the **evidence** — they tell you what actually happened.

# Agent Improvement Engine — Implementation Plan

## Context

Entire CLI collects rich session data (transcripts, token usage, AI summaries with friction/learnings, attribution metrics) but doesn't use it to help users improve. We're building three features:

1. **`entire insights`** — Session quality scoring, trends, agent comparisons
2. **`entire improve`** — Analyze friction patterns → suggest context file improvements
3. **Evolution loop** — Auto-trigger improvement suggestions after N sessions

### Architecture Decisions

| Decision | Choice | Why |
|----------|--------|-----|
| Local cache | SQLite (`modernc.org/sqlite`) | 2000 sessions/month scale needs indexed queries; bbolt would require hand-written query engine |
| Computed analytics storage | `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch, top-level `insights/` directory | Pre-computed scores/suggestions push to remote via existing pre-push hook; future frontend reads them directly |
| Raw data | Already on `entire/checkpoints/v1` | Transcripts, summaries, friction, tokens already stored and pushed |
| Binary size | +~8MB (32MB → 40MB) | Acceptable tradeoff for SQL query ergonomics at scale |
| Build constraint | `CGO_ENABLED=0` → `modernc.org/sqlite` (pure Go) | Only option; `.goreleaser.yaml` enforces static binary |
| Summarization | Required — `entire insights` and `entire improve` exit with message if disabled | Summaries (friction, learnings, intent/outcome) are the primary data source; scoring on tokens alone isn't useful enough |
| Score timing | At commit time (in CondenseSession, after summary) | Pure math <1ms; scores always on branch, always pushed, always available for frontend |
| Generator reuse | Shared base package for Claude CLI execution | Extract common logic (CLI invocation, response parsing, git isolation, `stripGitEnv`, `extractJSONFromMarkdown`) into shared package; summarize and improve provide different prompt templates |

---

## Data Architecture

### Three-Layer Storage

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 1: SQLite (.entire/insights.db)  — LOCAL CACHE       │
│  Fast indexed queries for CLI commands                      │
│  Populated from entire/checkpoints/v1                       │
│  Disposable — delete and rebuild from git                   │
└────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
                         │ reads from / writes to
                         ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 2: entire/checkpoints/v1 branch  — SOURCE OF TRUTH   │
│                                                             │
│  Existing (raw data):                                       │
│    <id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/                                       │
│      metadata.json          (CheckpointSummary)             │
│      0/metadata.json        (session: tokens, summary,      │
│      0/full.jsonl            friction, learnings, etc.)     │
│                                                             │
│  NEW (computed analytics):                                  │
│    insights/                                                │
│      scores/                                                │
│        <checkpoint-id>.json (SessionScore per checkpoint)   │
│      report.json            (latest InsightsReport)         │
│      suggestions/                                           │
│        <suggestion-id>.json (improvement suggestions)       │
│      evolution.json         (evolve state + history)        │
│                                                             │
└────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
                         │ git push (pre-push hook, already exists)
                         ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 3: Git Remote  — SHARED STATE                        │
│  Future frontend reads insights/ directory directly         │
│  No new API needed — git is the transport                   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### `insights/` Directory Schema (on `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch)

### SQLite Schema (`.entire/insights.db` — local cache)

```sql

CREATE TABLE cache_meta (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
);
-- Stores: 'branch_tip' → commit hash, 'last_rebuild' → timestamp

-- Denormalized session data for fast queries
CREATE TABLE sessions (
    checkpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    agent TEXT,
    model TEXT,
    branch TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    input_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,

-- Suggestion tracking (also written to branch)

```

## Scoring Algorithm

Weights: token efficiency (30%), first-pass success (30%), friction (25%), focus (15%)

| Dimension | Formula | Good | Poor |
|-----------|---------|------|------|
| Token efficiency | `100 * exp(-tokensPerFile/8000)` | 2k tok/file → 78 | 10k → 29 |
| First-pass | `80 - (friction * 10) - (turns>5 * 3) - (openItems * 5)` | 0 friction → 80 | 5 friction → 30 |
| Friction | `100 - (frictionCount * 20)` | 0 → 100 | 5 → 0 |
| Focus | file-to-turn ratio 0.5-3.0 → 90, else scales down | 2 files/3 turns → 90 | 1 file/15 turns → 50 |

Not exactly — insights is simpler because it doesn't need transcripts. Let me compare:

**Insights only needs numbers.** Scoring is pure math on metadata:

| Data | Source | Needs Transcript? |
|------|--------|---|
| Token usage | `CommittedMetadata.TokenUsage` | No |
| Turn count | `CommittedMetadata.SessionMetrics.TurnCount` | No |
| Friction count | `len(Summary.Friction)` | No |
| Files touched | `CommittedMetadata.FilesTouched` | No |
| Intent/outcome | `Summary.Intent`, `Summary.Outcome` | No |
| Agent/model | `CommittedMetadata.Agent`, `Model` | No |

All of this is already in SQLite from the cache population step. Insights queries are pure SQL:

```sql
-- Score trend over time
SELECT created_at, overall_score FROM sessions ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30;

-- Agent comparison
SELECT agent, AVG(overall_score), AVG(total_tokens), COUNT(*) FROM sessions GROUP BY agent;

-- Friction trend
SELECT created_at, COUNT(f.text) FROM sessions s
JOIN friction f ON s.checkpoint_id = f.checkpoint_id
GROUP BY s.checkpoint_id ORDER BY created_at;
```

**Improve needs to understand *why*.** That's why it reads transcripts.

```
entire insights                          entire improve
─────────────                            ──────────────
SQLite only                              SQLite → Git → Claude CLI
(scores, trends, comparisons)            (patterns → transcripts → suggestions)

"Your friction score dropped 15%"        "Here's WHY and what to add to CLAUDE.md"
"Claude Code uses 40% fewer tokens"      "Agents keep missing lint — add this rule"

No transcript reads                      Reads transcripts for evidence
No AI calls                              One AI call for suggestions
<1 second                                ~10-30 seconds
```

# Agent Improvement Engine — Implementation Plan

## Context

Entire CLI collects rich session data (transcripts, token usage, AI summaries with friction/learnings, attribution metrics) but doesn't use it to help users improve. We're building three features:

1. **`entire insights`** — Session quality scoring, trends, agent comparisons
2. **`entire improve`** — Analyze friction patterns → suggest context file improvements
3. **Evolution loop** — Auto-trigger improvement suggestions after N sessions

### Architecture Decisions

| Decision | Choice | Why |
|----------|--------|-----|
| Local cache | SQLite (`modernc.org/sqlite`) | 2000 sessions/month scale needs indexed queries; bbolt would require hand-written query engine |
| Computed analytics storage | `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch, top-level `insights/` directory | Pre-computed scores/suggestions push to remote via existing pre-push hook; future frontend reads them directly |
| Raw data | Already on `entire/checkpoints/v1` | Transcripts, summaries, friction, tokens already stored and pushed |
| Binary size | +~8MB (32MB → 40MB) | Acceptable tradeoff for SQL query ergonomics at scale |
| Build constraint | `CGO_ENABLED=0` → `modernc.org/sqlite` (pure Go) | Only option; `.goreleaser.yaml` enforces static binary |
| Summarization | Required — `entire insights` and `entire improve` exit with message if disabled | Summaries (friction, learnings, intent/outcome) are the primary data source; scoring on tokens alone isn't useful enough |
| Score timing | At commit time (in CondenseSession, after summary) | Pure math <1ms; scores always on branch, always pushed, always available for frontend |
| Generator reuse | Shared base package for Claude CLI execution | Extract common logic (CLI invocation, response parsing, git isolation, `stripGitEnv`, `extractJSONFromMarkdown`) into shared package; summarize and improve provide different prompt templates |

---

## Data Architecture

### Three-Layer Storage

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 1: SQLite (.entire/insights.db)  — LOCAL CACHE       │
│  Fast indexed queries for CLI commands                      │
│  Populated from entire/checkpoints/v1                       │
│  Disposable — delete and rebuild from git                   │
└────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
                         │ reads from / writes to
                         ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 2: entire/checkpoints/v1 branch  — SOURCE OF TRUTH   │
│                                                             │
│  Existing (raw data):                                       │
│    <id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/                                       │
│      metadata.json          (CheckpointSummary)             │
│      0/metadata.json        (session: tokens, summary,      │
│      0/full.jsonl            friction, learnings, etc.)     │
│                                                             │
│  NEW (computed analytics):                                  │
│    insights/                                                │
│      scores/                                                │
│        <checkpoint-id>.json (SessionScore per checkpoint)   │
│      report.json            (latest InsightsReport)         │
│      suggestions/                                           │
│        <suggestion-id>.json (improvement suggestions)       │
│      evolution.json         (evolve state + history)        │
│                                                             │
└────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
                         │ git push (pre-push hook, already exists)
                         ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 3: Git Remote  — SHARED STATE                        │
│  Future frontend reads insights/ directory directly         │
│  No new API needed — git is the transport                   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### SQLite Schema (`.entire/insights.db` — local cache)

## Implementation Phases

### Phase 1: Foundation

**1a. `termstyle/` package** — Extract shared styles from `status_style.go`
- `Styles` struct, `New(w)`, `Render()`, `SectionRule()`, `FormatTokenCount()`, etc.
- Refactor `status_style.go` to delegate

**1b. `llmcli/` package** — Extract shared Claude CLI execution from `summarize/claude.go`
- `Runner` struct: ClaudePath, Model, CommandRunner (same fields as current `ClaudeGenerator`)
- `Execute(ctx, prompt) (string, error)` — runs Claude CLI, parses `{"result": "string"}`, extracts JSON from markdown
- `stripGitEnv()`, `extractJSONFromMarkdown()` — moved here from summarize
- Refactor `summarize/claude.go` to use `llmcli.Runner` internally
- `improve/generator.go` also uses `llmcli.Runner` with its own prompt

**1c. SQLite cache** (`insightsdb/`)
- `db.go`: Open `.entire/insights.db`, WAL mode, migrations
- `cache.go`: `Rebuild()` from `entire/checkpoints/v1` via existing `GitStore.ListCommitted()` + `ReadSessionContent()`
- `RefreshIfStale()`: compare branch tip hash, rebuild only if changed
- `queries.go`: SQL functions for filter/aggregate/trend queries

**1d. Settings** — Add `EvolveSettings` to `settings.go`

### Phase 2: Scoring & Insights

**2a. `insights/` package** (pure logic, no I/O)
- `scorer.go`: `ScoreSession()` — composite scoring (token efficiency 30%, first-pass 30%, friction 25%, focus 15%)
- `trends.go`: `ComputeTrends()`, `ComputeAgentComparisons()`

**2b. Score at commit time** — Modify `manual_commit_condensation.go`
- After summary generation (line ~244), if summary is non-nil:
  - Call `insights.ScoreSession()` with summary data + token usage + session metrics
  - Write `insights/scores/<checkpoint-id>.json` to `entire/checkpoints/v1` using tree surgery
  - Update SQLite cache with new score
- This means scores are **always** on the branch and pushed with checkpoints
- Pure math, <1ms, no AI call — zero latency impact on commits

**2c. `entire insights` command**
- **Gate:** Check `settings.IsSummarizeEnabled()` — if false, print message and exit
- Refresh SQLite cache if stale
- Query scores from cache
- Compute trends + agent comparisons
- Update `insights/report.json` on branch with latest aggregated report
- Render terminal output using `termstyle`
- Flags: `--last N`, `--agent "name"`, `--json`

### Phase 3: Context Improver

**3a. `improve/` package**
- `context_files.go`: Detect CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, .gemini
- `analyzer.go`: Two-phase friction analysis:
  1. **Index phase** (SQLite): Query friction table for recurring themes (`GROUP BY text HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2`). Identify top N friction themes and which sessions they occurred in.
  2. **Deep-read phase** (git): For each high-friction session, read `full.jsonl` transcript from `entire/checkpoints/v1` via `GitStore.ReadSessionContent()`. Use existing `summarize.BuildCondensedTranscriptFromBytes()` to parse, then extract transcript excerpts around friction points (tool failures, retries, error messages).
  3. Return `PatternAnalysis` with: friction themes, transcript excerpts as evidence, learnings, open items
- `generator.go`: Build improvement prompt with:
  - Friction themes + **transcript excerpts showing what actually went wrong**
  - Aggregated learnings from summaries
  - Current context file contents
  - Call `llmcli.Runner`, parse suggestion JSON

**3b. Transcript excerpt extraction**
- Reuse `summarize.BuildCondensedTranscript()` to get `[]Entry` (user/assistant/tool entries)
- Scan for friction indicators: tool calls that failed, repeated edits to same file, error messages
- Extract ~20-30 entries around each friction point as context window
- This gives the improve prompt **specific evidence** rather than one-line friction labels

**3c. Write suggestions to checkpoint branch**
- Write `insights/suggestions/<id>.json` for each suggestion
- Pushes with next `git push`

**3d. `entire improve` command**
- **Gate:** Same summarization check as insights
- **Phase 1**: Query SQLite for recurring friction themes + affected sessions
- **Phase 2**: Read transcripts for top-friction sessions from git (limited to top N themes)
- **Phase 3**: Detect context files on disk
- **Phase 4**: Generate suggestions via `llmcli.Runner` (or `--dry-run` to show Phase 1 results only)
- Render colored diffs with evidence quotes
- Flags: `--last N`, `--dry-run`, `--json`

### Phase 4: Evolution Loop

**4a. `evolve/` package**
- `trigger.go`: `ShouldTrigger()` checks session count vs threshold
- `tracker.go`: Accept/reject suggestions, measure impact
  - On accept: record `pre_avg_score` from recent sessions in SQLite
  - After M subsequent sessions: compute `post_avg_score`, calculate delta
  - Show impact in `entire insights`: "Suggestion X improved scores by Y%"

**4b. Write evolution state to checkpoint branch**
- Write `insights/evolution.json` with evolve state
- Update on session end and after `entire improve` runs

**4c. Hook integration** — Wire into condensation path
- After condensation + scoring: increment `sessions_since_last_run` in SQLite + `insights/evolution.json`
- If threshold met: print tip suggesting `entire improve`
- No AI call in this path — just counter increment + optional print

| Summarize prompt | `summarize/claude.go:22-47` `summarizationPromptTemplate` | Stays in summarize, uses `llmcli.Runner` |

## Scoring Algorithm

Weights: token efficiency (30%), first-pass success (30%), friction (25%), focus (15%)

| Dimension | Formula | Good | Poor |
|-----------|---------|------|------|
| Token efficiency | `100 * exp(-tokensPerFile/8000)` | 2k tok/file → 78 | 10k → 29 |
| First-pass | `80 - (friction * 10) - (turns>5 * 3) - (openItems * 5)` | 0 friction → 80 | 5 friction → 30 |
| Friction | `100 - (frictionCount * 20)` | 0 → 100 | 5 → 0 |
| Focus | file-to-turn ratio 0.5-3.0 → 90, else scales down | 2 files/3 turns → 90 | 1 file/15 turns → 50 |

content.text:
Good question. Let me compare what we've designed against what AceAgent actually does.

## Our Design vs AceAgent — Feature Comparison

| Capability | AceAgent | Our Design | Gap? |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Collect session outcomes** | Manual — user writes description + notes + status after each task | Automatic — summarize generates intent/outcome/friction/learnings at commit time | We're **better** — no manual input needed |
| **Identify recurring patterns** | "Reflector" agent analyzes outcomes | `improve/analyzer.go` queries SQLite + reads transcripts | Comparable |
| **Generate improvement suggestions** | "Curator" agent updates playbook instructions | `improve/generator.go` generates CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md suggestions with diffs | Comparable |
| **Version the improvements** | Playbook versions with diffs, change summaries | Suggestions stored on `insights/` branch, tracked in SQLite | Comparable |
| **Measure impact** | Tracks "repeat errors", "cycle time", "first-pass quality" | Scores before/after suggestion acceptance | Comparable |
| **Auto-trigger evolution** | After 5+ outcomes | After N sessions (configurable threshold) | Same |
| **Score instruction effectiveness** | `[slug] helpful=N harmful=N` per instruction | Per-session composite score (token efficiency, friction, focus, first-pass) | **Different approach** — we score sessions, not individual instructions |
| **Seed from repo** | `ace seed` generates starter playbooks from docs | Not in our design | **Gap** |
| **Benchmark** | `ace benchmark` runs task with/without playbook, measures diff | Not in our design | **Gap** |
| **Team governance** | Playbook review workflow (draft → proposed → approved → archived) | Suggestions have status (pending/accepted/rejected), pushed to git | **Simpler** — no approval workflow |
| **Instruction-level tracking** | Each playbook rule has helpful/harmful counters | No per-rule tracking — we track per-session scores | **Gap** |
| **Export/import** | `ace export`/`ace import` for cross-environment | Data on git branch — clone/push/pull IS the transport | We're **better** — no separate sync |

## What We Do That ACE Doesn't

| | Us | ACE |
|---|---|---|
| **Full transcripts** | Store and analyze entire session transcripts | Only manual outcome notes |
| **Token analytics** | Token efficiency scoring, cost trends | No token tracking |
| **Agent comparison** | Compare Claude Code vs Cursor vs Gemini performance | Single agent only (via MCP) |
| **Attribution** | Agent vs human line contribution tracking | No attribution |
| **Git-native storage** | Everything on git branches, pushes with code | Separate database + optional cloud sync |
| **Automatic data collection** | Hooks capture everything without user action | User must manually record outcomes |

## Notable Gaps We Could Consider

**1. `entire seed` (ACE's `ace seed`)**
Generate initial CLAUDE.md from repo structure + first few sessions. We could add this — analyze first 3-5 session transcripts to bootstrap context files for a new repo.

**2. `entire benchmark` (ACE's `ace benchmark`)**
Run a standardized task with/without context files to measure improvement. Hard to automate (what task? what success criteria?) but could work with a user-defined prompt.

**3. Per-instruction effectiveness tracking**
ACE tracks which specific playbook rules help or hurt. We could parse CLAUDE.md into individual rules and correlate friction with specific rules present/absent. More complex but powerful.

content.text:
You're right — `seed` is basically `improve` on an empty CLAUDE.md. Same pipeline, just with `ContextFile{Exists: false}`. No need for a separate command.

Let me dig into **per-instruction effectiveness tracking** because this is where Entire could significantly surpass AceAgent.

## Per-Instruction Effectiveness Tracking

### What ACE Does (Simple)

ACE attaches counters to each playbook rule:
```
[use-strict-mode] helpful=12 harmful=2 :: Always use strict mode in TypeScript
```

These are **manually incremented** by the user/agent saying "this rule helped" or "this rule was wrong."

### What We Could Do (Data-Driven)

We have **full transcripts + summaries + friction + scores** for every session. We can **correlate** specific CLAUDE.md rules with session outcomes:

```
CLAUDE.md Rule: "Always run `mise run lint` before committing"
├── Added after session s10
├── Sessions before rule (s1-s10): avg friction score 45, "linting issues" in 6/10
├── Sessions after rule (s11-s25): avg friction score 82, "linting issues" in 1/15
└── Effectiveness: +37 friction score, 90% reduction in lint-related friction
```

### How It Would Work

```
Step 1: Parse CLAUDE.md into individual rules/instructions
        "# Section\n- Rule A\n- Rule B" → [{text: "Rule A", line: 3}, {text: "Rule B", line: 4}]

Step 2: Track when rules were added/modified/removed
        Compare CLAUDE.md content across checkpoints on the branch
        → rule_history table: (rule_hash, first_seen_at, removed_at, text)

Step 3: For each rule, partition sessions into "before" and "after"
        before = sessions where checkpoint.created_at < rule.first_seen_at
        after  = sessions where checkpoint.created_at >= rule.first_seen_at

Step 4: Correlate with friction
        For each rule, check if related friction themes decreased after the rule was added
        Use keyword matching: rule mentions "lint" → check friction containing "lint"

Step 5: Compute effectiveness
        - Friction reduction: % decrease in related friction themes
        - Score impact: avg session score before vs after
        - Still active: is the friction theme still occurring?
```

### SQLite Tables for This

```sql
-- Parse CLAUDE.md into rules
CREATE TABLE context_rules (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,           -- hash of normalized rule text
    file_type TEXT NOT NULL,       -- 'CLAUDE.md', 'AGENTS.md', etc.
    section TEXT,                  -- heading the rule lives under
    text TEXT NOT NULL,            -- the rule text
    first_seen_checkpoint TEXT,    -- checkpoint when rule first appeared
    first_seen_at TEXT,            -- timestamp
    removed_checkpoint TEXT,       -- null if still active
    removed_at TEXT,
    keywords TEXT                  -- extracted keywords for friction matching
);

-- Link rules to friction themes they address
CREATE TABLE rule_friction_correlation (
    rule_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES context_rules(id),
    friction_theme TEXT NOT NULL,  -- normalized friction theme
    friction_before INTEGER,       -- count in sessions before rule
    friction_after INTEGER,        -- count in sessions after rule
    score_before REAL,             -- avg score in sessions before rule
    score_after REAL,              -- avg score in sessions after rule
    last_computed TEXT              -- when this was last calculated
);
```

### What the Output Could Look Like

```
entire insights --rules

── Rule Effectiveness ─────────────────────────

  +37  "Always run mise run lint before committing"         CLAUDE.md:15
       Lint friction: 6/10 sessions → 1/15 sessions
       Added 15 sessions ago

  +22  "Use t.Parallel() in all tests"                     CLAUDE.md:42
       Test timeout friction: 3/8 → 0/12
       Added 12 sessions ago

   0   "Never use go-git for checkout operations"           CLAUDE.md:88
       No related friction detected before or after
       Consider: may be preventive (no data to measure)

  -5   "Always use huh.NewForm for confirmations"           CLAUDE.md:61
       Form-related friction: 0/10 → 2/8
       Consider: rule may be causing confusion
```

### The Hard Part: Rule ↔ Friction Matching

How do you know that the rule "Always run lint" relates to friction "Lint errors not caught"? Options:

1. **Keyword matching** — extract keywords from rules and friction, check overlap. Simple but misses semantic relationships.

2. **LLM-assisted matching** — one Claude call: "Given these rules and these friction themes, which rules address which friction?" More accurate but costs tokens.

3. **Both** — keyword matching for the fast path, LLM for ambiguous cases.

# Agent Improvement Engine — Implementation Plan

## Context

Entire CLI collects rich session data (transcripts, token usage, AI summaries with friction/learnings, attribution metrics) but doesn't use it to help users improve. We're building three features:

1. **`entire insights`** — Session quality scoring, trends, agent comparisons
2. **`entire improve`** — Analyze friction patterns → suggest context file improvements
3. **Evolution loop** — Auto-trigger improvement suggestions after N sessions

### Architecture Decisions

| Decision | Choice | Why |
|----------|--------|-----|
| Local cache | SQLite (`modernc.org/sqlite`) | 2000 sessions/month scale needs indexed queries; bbolt would require hand-written query engine |
| Computed analytics storage | `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch, top-level `insights/` directory | Pre-computed scores/suggestions push to remote via existing pre-push hook; future frontend reads them directly |
| Raw data | Already on `entire/checkpoints/v1` | Transcripts, summaries, friction, tokens already stored and pushed |
| Binary size | +~8MB (32MB → 40MB) | Acceptable tradeoff for SQL query ergonomics at scale |
| Build constraint | `CGO_ENABLED=0` → `modernc.org/sqlite` (pure Go) | Only option; `.goreleaser.yaml` enforces static binary |
| Summarization | Required — `entire insights` and `entire improve` exit with message if disabled | Summaries (friction, learnings, intent/outcome) are the primary data source; scoring on tokens alone isn't useful enough |
| Score timing | At commit time (in CondenseSession, after summary) | Pure math <1ms; scores always on branch, always pushed, always available for frontend |
| Generator reuse | Shared base package for Claude CLI execution | Extract common logic (CLI invocation, response parsing, git isolation, `stripGitEnv`, `extractJSONFromMarkdown`) into shared package; summarize and improve provide different prompt templates |

---

## Data Architecture

### Three-Layer Storage

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 1: SQLite (.entire/insights.db)  — LOCAL CACHE       │
│  Fast indexed queries for CLI commands                      │
│  Populated from entire/checkpoints/v1                       │
│  Disposable — delete and rebuild from git                   │
└────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
                         │ reads from / writes to
                         ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 2: entire/checkpoints/v1 branch  — SOURCE OF TRUTH   │
│                                                             │
│  Existing (raw data):                                       │
│    <id[:2]>/<id[2:]>/                                       │
│      metadata.json          (CheckpointSummary)             │
│      0/metadata.json        (session: tokens, summary,      │
│      0/full.jsonl            friction, learnings, etc.)     │
│                                                             │
│  NEW (computed analytics):                                  │
│    insights/                                                │
│      scores/                                                │
│        <checkpoint-id>.json (SessionScore per checkpoint)   │
│      report.json            (latest InsightsReport)         │
│      suggestions/                                           │
│        <suggestion-id>.json (improvement suggestions)       │
│      evolution.json         (evolve state + history)        │
│                                                             │
└────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
                         │ git push (pre-push hook, already exists)
                         ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Layer 3: Git Remote  — SHARED STATE                        │
│  Future frontend reads insights/ directory directly         │
│  No new API needed — git is the transport                   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### `insights/` Directory Schema (on `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch)

```
insights/
├── scores/
│   └── <checkpoint-id>.json     # Per-checkpoint session score
│       {
│         "checkpoint_id": "a3b2c4d5e6f7",
│         "session_id": "2026-03-24-uuid",
│         "agent": "Claude Code",

│           "friction_score": 90,
│           "focus_score": 60
│         },
│         "tokens_used": 5000,
│         "turn_count": 3,
│         "files_count": 3,
│         "friction_count": 1
│       }
│
├── report.json                  # Latest aggregated insights report
│   {
│     "generated_at": "2026-03-24T12:00:00Z",
│     "period": "last 30 sessions",
│     "trends": [...],
│     "agent_comparisons": [...],
│     "session_count": 30
│   }
│
├── suggestions/
│   └── <suggestion-id>.json     # Individual improvement suggestion
│       {
│         "id": "sug-1711234567-0",
│         "file_type": "CLAUDE.md",
│         "category": "fix_friction",

    }
```

### SQLite Schema (`.entire/insights.db` — local cache)

```sql
-- Cache freshness tracking
CREATE TABLE cache_meta (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
);
-- Stores: 'branch_tip' → commit hash, 'last_rebuild' → timestamp

-- Denormalized session data for fast queries
CREATE TABLE sessions (
    checkpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    agent TEXT,
    model TEXT,
    branch TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    input_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    cache_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    output_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    api_call_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    duration_ms INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    turn_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    intent TEXT,
    outcome TEXT,
    agent_percentage REAL DEFAULT 0,
    -- Pre-computed score (also written to branch)
    overall_score REAL,
    score_token_efficiency REAL,
    score_first_pass REAL,
    score_friction REAL,
    score_focus REAL,
    PRIMARY KEY (checkpoint_id, session_index)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_created ON sessions(created_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_agent ON sessions(agent);

CREATE TABLE files_touched (
    checkpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_index INTEGER NOT NULL,

);

CREATE TABLE friction (
    checkpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE learnings (
    checkpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,

-- Suggestion tracking (also written to branch)
CREATE TABLE suggestions (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    file_type TEXT NOT NULL,

```
